home.role: If you can read this, you must not be an ordinary person
home.intro: Explore and visualize core Machine Learning algorithms and scientific Sampling methods. Learn how to collect data intelligently and build robust predictive models.

pro_tools.title: Pro Tools.
pro_tools.tool_1_desc: Fine-tune and cluster complex multidimensional data with precision.
pro_tools.tool_2_desc: Full pipeline execution control from ingestion to inference.
pro_tools.tool_2_status_idle: System ready. Select a step to execute...
pro_tools.tool_3_desc: Personalized visual themes designed for maximum reading clarity.
pro_tools.tool_4_desc: Interactive feedback systems built with clean, reactive patterns.
pro_tools.tool_1_usage: Click the 'SHUFFLE COORDINATES' button or click directly on the simulation box to reallocate data points. You will see lines connecting each point to its nearest cluster centroid, demonstrating the K-Means algorithm clustering via Euclidean distance.
pro_tools.tool_2_usage: Click the pipeline state buttons: 'IN' (Data Ingestion), 'PROC' (Processing), or 'OUT' (Data Inference) to execute each step and view real-time performance logs below.
pro_tools.tool_3_usage: Select a UI theme: 'Dark' (developer mode), 'Light' (high contrast), or 'Kino' (cinematic style). The page colors and background particle generator will adapt immediately.
pro_tools.tool_4_usage: Adjust frequency filters by clicking 'Bass', 'Mid', 'Treble', or 'Boost' to adjust spectral density. Click directly on the meter bars to Play or Pause the real-time audio wave visualization.

ml.title: Machine Learning Topics
ml.subtitle: Explore various algorithms and concepts in Machine Learning.

pca.title: PCA
pca.desc: Principal Component Analysis for dimensionality reduction.

kmeans.title: K-Means
kmeans.desc: Clustering algorithm to partition data into K distinct groups.

naive_bayes.title: Naive Bayes
naive_bayes.desc: Probabilistic classifier based on Bayes' theorem.

logistic_regression.title: Logistic Regression
logistic_regression.desc: Statistical model used for binary classification.

svm.title: SVM
svm.desc: Support Vector Machines for robust classification and regression.

sampling.title: Sampling Techniques
sampling.subtitle: Discover scientific methods to select representative samples from large populations.

simple_random.title: Simple Random Sampling
simple_random.desc: Every individual in the population has an exactly equal chance of being selected.

stratified.title: Stratified Sampling
stratified.desc: Splits the population into key subgroups (strata) and samples from each proportionally.

systematic.title: Systematic Sampling
systematic.desc: Selects elements at a regular, fixed mathematical interval from an ordered list.

cluster.title: Cluster Sampling
cluster.desc: Divides population into natural clusters, then randomly chooses entire clusters to study.

descriptive_inferential.title: Descriptive & Inferential Statistics
descriptive_inferential.desc: Calculate basic statistics (mean, variance, standard deviation) and perform hypothesis testing like t-test, ANOVA, and Chi-square.

regression_models.title: Regression Models
regression_models.desc: Master Linear Regression and Logistic Regression to uncover relationships between variables.

about.title: About KaSao
about.subtitle: An educational and interactive web portal for Machine Learning and Sampling science.
about.intro: KaSao was built to bridge the gap between academic formulas and visual intuition. By combining rigorous mathematics with modern, interactive simulations, we make complex data concepts accessible and engaging.
about.ml_desc: Explore core algorithms (PCA, K-Means, Naive Bayes, Logistic Regression, SVM) with detailed theoretical frameworks, formula derivations, and step-by-step explanations.
about.sampling_desc: Configure population sizes, stratify groupings, define step intervals, and visualize random cluster selections in real-time using custom HTML5 canvas simulators.
about.academic_desc: Review clear mathematical definitions. From Cochrane's formula to Neyman Allocation and Design Effects, all formulas are rendered in high-fidelity LaTeX.
about.ui_desc: Experience a premium editorial interface with particle physics backgrounds, responsive dark/light/cinematic modes, and smooth micro-animations.
about.tech_desc: Built with modern software architecture to ensure speed, accessibility, and clean design patterns.
about.tech_frontend_details: React 19, TypeScript, Vite 8, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion for premium web layout and animations.
about.tech_backend_details: FastAPI (Python 3.12+), SQLAlchemy ORM, SQLite database for high-performance API endpoint services.

tools.title: Tools & Programming
tools.subtitle: Master the primary software languages, tools, and databases used for data analysis.

analysis_languages.title: Deep Analysis Languages
analysis_languages.desc: Leverage R for stats and data viz, or Python (Pandas, NumPy, Statsmodels) for machine learning integrations.

classical_software.title: Classical Statistical Software
classical_software.desc: Professional software (SPSS, Stata, EViews) used in traditional market research and economics.

sql_database.title: Raw Data Management & Cleaning
sql_database.desc: Write queries to filter, clean, and prepare data from databases for analysis.

pro_tools_page.title: Interactive Control Panel
pro_tools_page.subtitle: Visualize and interact with machine learning clustering algorithms, data pipelines, theme customizers, and spectrum meters.
